# uptimekuma_notification_ntfy (Resource)

ntfy notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_ntfy" "example" {
  name       = "ntfy.sh Notifications"
  topic      = "my_uptime_kuma_notifications"
  priority   = 5
  server_url = "https://ntfy.sh"
  icon       = "https://example.com/icon.png"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_ntfy" "high_priority" {
  name       = "ntfy Critical Alerts"
  topic      = "critical_alerts"
  priority   = 1
  server_url = "https://ntfy.sh"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = true
}

# Self hosted ntfy server, authenticated with an access token.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_ntfy" "access_token" {
  name       = "ntfy Self Hosted"
  topic      = "uptime_kuma"
  server_url = "https://ntfy.example.com"

  authentication_method = "accessToken"
  access_token          = var.ntfy_access_token

  priority      = 5
  priority_down = 1
}

# Self hosted ntfy server, authenticated with username and password, using
# custom title and message templates.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_ntfy" "username_password" {
  name       = "ntfy Self Hosted (Basic Auth)"
  topic      = "uptime_kuma"
  server_url = "https://ntfy.example.com"

  authentication_method = "usernamePassword"
  username              = var.ntfy_username
  password              = var.ntfy_password

  use_template   = true
  custom_title   = "{{ name }} is {{ status }}"
  custom_message = "{{ msg }}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name
- `topic` (String) ntfy topic the notifications are published to.

### Optional

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) ntfy access token, used when `authentication_method` is `accessToken`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `authentication_method` (String) Authentication method used to talk to the ntfy server. One of `none`, `usernamePassword` or `accessToken`. Defaults to `none`.
- `call` (String) Phone number to call for every notification, or `yes` to call the account's verified number (ntfy `X-Call` header).
- `custom_message` (String) Custom message template. Only used if `use_template` is `true`.
- `custom_title` (String) Custom title template. Only used if `use_template` is `true`.
- `icon` (String) URL of the icon attached to the notification.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) ntfy password, used when `authentication_method` is `usernamePassword`.
- `priority` (Number) Priority of the notification, between 1 and 5. Used for all notifications and as the basis for the down priority when `priority_down` is not set. Defaults to `5`.
- `priority_down` (Number) Priority of the notification sent when a monitor goes down, between 1 and 5. If not set, Uptime Kuma uses `priority` + 1, capped at 5.
- `server_url` (String) URL of the ntfy server. Defaults to `https://ntfy.sh`.
- `use_template` (Boolean) Use `custom_title` and `custom_message` instead of the default notification title and message.
- `username` (String) ntfy username, used when `authentication_method` is `usernamePassword`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
